title: T-107 Slice 3 — MECH_01 ¡MANTÉN! new inverted-pendulum balance mechanic
description: Slice 3 of the TASK-034 (GDD T-107) split — new mechanic. Inverted-pendulum balance per GDD §4 MECH_01, on the canonical §10.2 v2 IMicrogame contract (engine-free Core sim, injected SeededRandom, zero-alloc Tick). AlcocheckSim.cs is prior art to mine, not a constraint. FIDELITY RULED (human 2026-07-07, both [ASSUMED]-tagged + reviewer-verified for determinism and feel): (a) perturbation uses a DETERMINISTIC seeded-noise substitute (value-noise / interpolated, not required to be true Perlin) preserving the ramping amplitude A(t) = A0 + ramp·t — a new engine-free noise helper is in-scope since none exists in Core; (b) keep a small DAMPING term for Euler integration stability, as a documented deviation from the GDD's literal undamped ODE. Model: θ'' = (g/L)·sin(θ) + perturbation(t) − k·input (+ damping); fail at |θ| > θmax (35° default); L/R torque only; victory = last standing or lowest mean |θ|. Declare difficultyScaling; pass the TASK-030 validator.
acceptance_criteria: MECH_01 implements the v2 IMicrogame contract as an engine-free Core sim (injected SeededRandom, zero-alloc Tick); L/R torque only; fail at |theta| > 35° (default, configurable).

Perturbation is a deterministic seeded-noise substitute with ramping amplitude A(t)=A0+ramp·t; the noise helper and the retained damping term are both [ASSUMED]-tagged as deviations from the GDD-literal ODE.
With null input, every pendulum falls before duration on all test seeds; with simulated perfect correction, 100% survive.
A replay determinism test passes (two independently constructed sims with the same seed produce identical θ trajectories and outcome).
The v2 definition declares difficultyScaling params and passes the TASK-030 validator.
Tests-first (red captured); victory resolution (last-standing or lowest mean |theta|) handles ties without fabricated winners; fast suite green, no regression; legacy consumers keep compiling.

comments.author: dev-t101
comments.body:
Hand-off. tdd two-commit: 24d8938 test RED (whole-project compile-red: CS0234 MantenMicrogame absent, CS0246 MantenParams/SeededValueNoise1D absent) -> edf1526 feat GREEN. Suite 610/610 (578+32: 24 MantenMicrogameV2Tests + 8 SeededValueNoise1DTests). Legacy consumers compile (additive MicrogameId.Manten=3).

NOISE HELPER (Barcade.Core.SeededValueNoise1D, RNG folder): lattice of independently-seeded [-1,1] values drawn ONCE from the injected SeededRandom at construction, smoothstep-interpolated between neighbors; Sample() zero-alloc. NoisePointsPerSecond=4 (private engineering constant, not a GDD param — same status as AlcocheckSim's drunkChangeInterval) makes the wobble continuous vs a discrete re-roll.

[ASSUMED] TAGS (both cite the human ruling, both in-code): (1) value-noise not true Perlin (SeededValueNoise1D + MantenMicrogame class docs); (2) damping term (MantenParams.Damping) for Euler stability, GDD ODE is literally undamped.

TWO MORE ASSUMPTIONS NOT PRE-RULED (flagged, not guessed silently): (3) SHARED perturbation curve across all 4 seats — one noise instance/round, same perturbación(t) applied to every seat's angularAccel each tick, NOT 4 independent per-seat curves. GDD's formula names a single 'seed, t' with no player index, so read as one shared 'gust'. Consequence: seats with identical initial conditions + identical input fall on the EXACT same tick, byte-identical trajectories. Independent per-seat sway is a straightforward change (4 noise instances) if wanted. THIS IS THE ONE REAL DESIGN FORK wanting a human read. (4) difficultyScaling target — GDD names no difficultyScaling list for MECH_01 like §11.1's MECH_04 example; mapped difficultyMult -> perturbAmplitude0+perturbRamp (the 'how strong/dense is the disturbance' analog of Esquiva's hazardSpeed+spawnRate), leaving gravityFactor/torqueGain/thetaMax as fixed physics constants. Declared DifficultyScaling=[perturbAmplitude0,perturbRamp].

CORRECTION ORACLE (CorrectionOracle, test-only): reactive PD-style full-authority bang-bang, NOT a hardcoded survivor. Reads ONLY RenderEntity.Rotation (theta degrees — the only channel a real observer of rendered tilt has) + its own previous-tick memory for a finite-difference velocity estimate; never touches sim private state. errorSignal = theta + Kd*velocityEstimate (Kd=0.15), pushes full E/W on deadband cross, SAME sign as predicted lean (the GDD formula subtracts torqueGain*input, so countering disturbance D needs input of the SAME sign as D — derived + documented in the class doc). Diagonal-input test proves the sign/magnitude convention; the 20-seed oracle sweep (real PCG32) proves it holds under noise.

GddDefaults (tuned via a THROWAWAY System.Random prototype in scratch — NOT committed; committed tests use real PCG32 SeededRandom): gravityFactor=3.0, perturbAmplitude0=1.2, perturbRamp=0.3, torqueGain=10.0, thetaMaxDegrees=35 (GDD literal), damping=1.2, durationSeconds=8.0 (top of GDD's 5-8s note — the extra time is what makes null-input-always-falls reliable across seeds). Both AC3 sweeps (null-falls seeds 0-19, oracle-survives seeds 0-19) passed FIRST run vs real PCG32, no iteration.

ZERO-ALLOC SENSOR (M1, written in-ticket per the brief): SteadyStateTick_AllocatesNoManagedMemory uses gravityFactor=perturbAmplitude0=perturbRamp=0 (every force term EXACTLY zero, not a probabilistic margin) so liveness across the 1000-tick window is mathematically guaranteed, while the full noise+integration hot path still executes (Sample IS called, result multiplied by amplitude=0, not skipped). MUTATION-RED: new int[1] as Sample's first line -> 'Failed SteadyStateTick_AllocatesNoManagedMemory / Expected: 0 / But was: 32000', reverted, grepped clean.

GDD AMBIGUITY SURFACED (item 3 above) is the one I'd most want the human's read on — a real design fork, picked the literal-formula-favoring interpretation without a ruling behind it.
